candidats.description: 6-pin Addressable Gen2 ARGB header cable included with Asus Z690 Maximus Extreme motherboard. It splits into two 3-pin addressable gen2 male header plugs. It is apparently a proprietary cable.

Mohács railway station. History: The station was established by the Pécs-Mohács railway, the Danube Steam Shipping Company in 1857. The opening took place on May 2, 1857, but at that time the railway was opened only for coal transport. The railway line to Pécs was implemented with the aim that the coal extracted from Mecsek is transported by rail until now, and here at Mohács it is transhipped to a ship at the port. That is why the station was built directly on the bank of the Danube. The line was opened in July 1857 for other freight, but not until 24 April 1859. - Indóház Street, Budapesti S
